options.reason: The table holds log-scale RNA-seq values for 115 CPTAC-BRCA tumours plus a two-level 'label' column (68 positive, 47 negative), which matches the brief's aim of predicting progesterone-receptor status from gene expression; gene features are measured independently of the receptor call, so no column recodes the outcome and sample_id is the only row key. Several classifiers can be cross-validated on the training rows, with the held-out predictions then used for discrimination, calibration and decision-curve reporting.
